liquidityCallback(address,uint256,bytes).details: Callback from Liquidity to transfer tokens during operate. Pulls from team multisig via approval.

params.onBehalf_: the address (protocol) whose debt to pay back

paybackOnBehalf(address,int256,address).notice: Pays back debt on behalf of `onBehalf_` at the Liquidity layer. Only callable by team multisig.         For ERC20: team multisig must have approved this contract for the payback amount.         For native token: send the payback amount as msg.value.

rescueTokens(address,uint256,address).notice: Rescues stuck tokens from this contract. Only callable by team multisig.

userdoc.notice: Pay back debt on behalf of any address via Liquidity.operateOnBehalfOf. Multisig only.
